summary: Contractual physiotherapist status under 1992/2022 Rules; 'initial constitution' provision applicable; ad hoc employees eligible for deemed appointment; tribunal directed consideration as initial constituent; high court extended compliance time; counsel's statement binding despite lack of instructions; misunderstanding no ground to recall; contempt proceeding initiated; concession estoppel bars appeal; final compliance order not issued; tribunal's decision upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Sports Authority of India (Sports Sciences and Sports Medicine) Staff Recruitment Rules, 1992
Sports Authority of India Executive Cadre (Grade A) Staff Recruitment Rules 2022
S.S. Moghe and Others v Union of India and others
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court's refusal to recall order upheld; tribunal's directions affirmed; status as initial constituent to be decided per 2022 Rules.
